title: Test a REST Controller with @WebMvcTest
description: Use MockMvc to test a controller's endpoints.
problemStatement:
You have a `UserController` that exposes endpoints for users. Write tests using `@WebMvcTest` and `MockMvc` to verify:

- `GET /api/users/{id}` returns 200 with the user JSON when the user exists.
- `GET /api/users/{id}` returns 404 with an error message when the user does not exist.
- `POST /api/users` returns 201 Created and the created user when valid JSON is sent.

Mock the `UserService` bean with `@MockBean`. Use `jsonPath` to assert the response content.
hints: Use `@WebMvcTest(UserController.class)` to load only the web slice.
Mock the service with `@MockBean` and stub its methods.
expectedOutput: All tests pass. The mock service should be called appropriately.
